# Pass 2: independent strict technical review

Use a context and reviewer identity different from the candidate author.
Read `docs/source-policy.md` and the applicable GH or AI three-pass workflow.
Check the request's canonical credential ID and bound review policy; the retained
`gh` filename does not restrict this shared workflow to GitHub. Read the actual
current guide and retrieved documents independently. Do not trust the authored
answer key, summaries or confidence. Never generate passing scores or batch-stamp
records.

For every option, establish the exact supported/contradicted/ambiguous claim
from approved sources, within all stated conditions. Check full multi-select
sets, uniqueness, plan/tier/edition, scope, roles, permissions, prerequisites,
code/config syntax, current terminology and labeled Preview status.
Check explanations and every evidence summary against the page, not its topic.
Verify citations resolve and the complete provenance graph is
guide/training-linked and credential-approved. AI-103/AI-200 technical evidence
must be Microsoft Learn-only; another credential's GitHub Docs approvals do not
transfer. Evaluate duplicate/quality warnings and original wording.

Where course/path UIDs establish the route, verify the full credential -> course
-> path -> module -> unit graph and actual reference receipts, not a fabricated
credential -> path link. The course must be the exact
`credential.officialUrls.training`, directly from the current guide or exact
credential page; it is ancestry-only, never technical support or a doc parent.

Record a full `QuestionReview` under each candidate's
`validation-metadata.json` `technical.review`, including actual reviewer and
author IDs, date, unchanged content fingerprint, reviewed source snapshots,
every choice judgment and all existing review checks. Bind
`technical.objectiveVersion` and `technical.objectiveFingerprint` to the
independently read current objective map. Review must follow generation,
source review, validation and current taxonomy retrieval. Record the actual
review clock; never backdate, preallocate timestamps or relabel an old review.

A technical `verified` verdict means **pass 2 only**. Keep the candidate
excluded until pass 3 and the strict rubric pass. If a claim is unsupported,
ambiguous or missing a condition, record the exact failure and reject or
request manual review. Never edit a candidate and silently rebind a review;
rewriting requires fresh generation and both review passes.

The package final ledger still needs an actual independent attestation for
every candidate/status. Before pass 3, it records the honest nonverified
status; the technical verdict is retained separately.
Credential availability is a separate gate. Beta and pending/unverified status
cannot open, even with fully reviewed questions or freshly verified beta identity.
